The primary intelligibility failures are: (1) severe audio/text channel collisions in Sequences A, B, and C where 'Lane Control' and 'Scout Channel' radio voices speak directly over the 'Onboarding Assistant' while the player is busy dodging bullets; (2) missing explicit keybind prompts for 'focus', 'fire', and 'Writ' in the tutorial (Sequence G), leaving the player unable to fire; (3) ambiguous scoring/disarm rules where shooting vs scanning triggers 'Rate adjusted' or boss dialogue ('My POD!' in Sequence D) without clear visual cause; and (4) minor UI issues including red color-coding for beneficial Lock Time reduction (Sequence F) and missing stat panels in portrait/narrow aspect ratio (Sequence H)."}
